facts.text: You establish the entrance and the signs of the disrupted work at {siteName}.

cause.text: The delivery party reports broken carrying straps.
A dangerous presence blocks the delivery party's route.

custody.text: The delivery party left these goods behind.
Any abandoned supplies still belong to the delivery party.

hazard.text: The goods lie near the entrance; recovery requires no further fighting.
Defeat the main threat deep inside {siteName}.

materialState.text: Some goods remain usable; sound packaging could save more.
No goods need to be recovered.

resolutions.label: Hand over the recovered {subjectName} to {merchantName}
resolutions.reply: {merchantName} takes the usable {subjectName} and adds them to the shop's stock.

resolutions.label: Deliver the goods with evidence of the failed straps
resolutions.reply: You hand over the usable goods and explain the failed straps. The evidence earns additional personal trust.

resolutions.label: Report what you found without fulfilling the commission
resolutions.reply: You report the signs at {siteName}. The agreed work remains unfinished; this closes the commission with partial payment.

resolutions.label: Report the main threat defeated
resolutions.reply: The main threat at {siteName} is defeated. Other dangers remain.

resolutions.label: Report what you found without fulfilling the commission
resolutions.reply: You report the signs at {siteName}. The agreed work remains unfinished; this closes the commission with partial payment.

facts.text: The broken straps and scrape marks establish accidental abandonment.
You take custody of the usable goods from this consignment.
Sound packaging lets you carry back more usable goods.

proceduralBundles.name: Recover the Abandoned Shipment
proceduralBundles.description: {giverName} commissions you to recover a missing shipment for {merchantName}. Locate the goods and return them so {merchantName} can sell the supplies again.

facts.text: A consignment lies abandoned near the entrance.

actions.label: Corroborate the cause (Investigation; retries add fatigue)

facts.text: Drag marks show where the straps failed; the goods were dropped.

resolutions.label: Return the recovered goods to {merchantName}
resolutions.reply: The goods are back. {merchantName} can put this shipment on the shelves.

resolutions.label: Return the goods with a corroborated account
resolutions.reply: {merchantName} can put the shipment on the shelves. Your evidence explains the broken straps and earns further trust in your account.

resolutions.label: Report the location without recovering the goods
resolutions.reply: You found the consignment, but the shipment is still missing from our shelves.

proceduralBundles.name: Settle the Kit Dispute
proceduralBundles.description: {giverName} asks you to settle a custody dispute between {witnessName} and {claimantName}. Hear both accounts and examine the deposited survey kit’s marks.

facts.text: The kit bears overlapping custody marks.
{witnessName} says the kit was deposited for safekeeping.
{claimantName} says the kit was transferred for their work.

actions.label: Corroborate the cause (Investigation; retries add fatigue)

facts.text: The dated marks show the kit remained in {witnessName}’s custody; {claimantName}’s mark records a loan for their work.

resolutions.label: Place the kit with {witnessName}
resolutions.reply: The kit is back in {witnessName}’s keeping. {claimantName} still disputes the decision.

resolutions.label: Support the first claimant with corroborated custody evidence
resolutions.reply: The dated custody marks support returning the kit to {witnessName}. {claimantName} accepts the evidence behind your decision.

resolutions.label: Place the kit with {claimantName}
resolutions.reply: The kit is now in {claimantName}’s keeping. {witnessName} still disagrees, but the decision is made.

proceduralBundles.name: Check the Theft Report
proceduralBundles.description: {giverName} asks you to check a report that a consignment was stolen. Examine the site before accepting that account.

facts.text: A damaged crate remains at the reported site.
There is no sign of forced entry.

actions.label: Corroborate the cause (Investigation; retries add fatigue)

facts.text: The breakage corroborates damage during handling. The supposedly missing goods remain sealed inside the crate.

resolutions.label: Report what you saw without accusing anyone
resolutions.reply: You checked the site, but we still cannot call this theft.

resolutions.label: Correct the theft report
resolutions.reply: The damage happened during handling. I will correct the account instead of accusing someone of theft.

proceduralBundles.name: Explain the Damaged Delivery
proceduralBundles.description: {giverName} asks you to explain a damaged delivery. Compare {witnessName}’s account with the physical signs.

facts.text: Crushed packing lies beside the damaged goods.
{witnessName} describes the load shifting before it was unloaded.

actions.label: Corroborate the cause (Investigation; retries add fatigue)

facts.text: The witness account and pressure marks corroborate a packing fault.

resolutions.label: Report the observations without claiming a cause
resolutions.reply: Your report narrows the problem, but does not establish its cause.

resolutions.label: Report the corroborated packing fault
resolutions.reply: The packing caused the damage. Your evidence gives us a reason to change how we pack.

description: Quest templates for campaign and procedural side quest generation

campaignQuests.name: The Monster Threat
campaignQuests.description: Investigate the recent surge in monster attacks near {settlement}.

objectives.description: Report findings to the village elder

campaignQuests.name: The Ancient Blight
campaignQuests.description: Discover the cause of the monster blight in the nearby ruins.

objectives.description: Find and enter the ancient ruins
Bring the artifact to the village elder

campaignQuests.name: The Enemy Stronghold
campaignQuests.description: Track the blight to its origin - an enemy fortress.

campaignQuests.name: Confronting the BBEG
campaignQuests.description: Face the mastermind behind the blight and end the threat.

sideQuestTemplates.name: {creatureNamePlural} Menace
sideQuestTemplates.description: The local {npcRole} has asked you to deal with {count} {creatureName} threatening {settlement}.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Hunt the {creatureName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: {npcName} needs a skilled hunter to eliminate a particularly dangerous {creatureName} that has been terrorizing travelers near {settlement}.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Lost {itemType}
sideQuestTemplates.description: {npcName} has lost their precious {itemName} in the nearby {dungeonType}. They're offering a reward for its safe return.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Urgent Message
sideQuestTemplates.description: {npcName} needs you to deliver an important message to {targetNpc} in {targetSettlement}.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Supply Delivery
sideQuestTemplates.description: {npcName} needs someone to deliver {itemName} to {targetNpc} in {targetSettlement}.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Scout {locationName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: {npcName} needs reconnaissance on the nearby {locationType}. Explore the area and report back.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Disarm the Traps
sideQuestTemplates.description: {npcName} reports that traps have been set near {settlement}. Use your skills to find and disable them.

sideQuestTemplates.name: The Bandits Threatening {settlementName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: Bandits are demanding tribute from {settlement}. {npcName} wants them gone — whether through words or fear.

objectives.description: Negotiate with or intimidate the bandit leader

intelDialogue.high: They're camped at {dungeonName}, to the {direction}. I know exactly where.
intelDialogue.medium: Somewhere to the {direction}. I've seen their scouts on that road.
intelDialogue.low: They come from the {direction}. I haven't found the camp.
intelDialogue.none: I have no idea where they're based.

sideQuestTemplates.name: {enemyType} Warlord {bossName} of {dungeonName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: A named {enemyType} warlord leads raids from {dungeonName}. The settlement elders want them dead.

intelDialogue.high: I know exactly where {bossName} lairs — {dungeonName}, to the {direction}.
intelDialogue.medium: Somewhere to the {direction}. A ruin, I think.
intelDialogue.low: I've only heard rumours from the merchants.
intelDialogue.none: I have no information to give you.

sideQuestTemplates.name: The Bounty on {bossName}: Dead or Alive
sideQuestTemplates.description: A merchant who was robbed by {bossName} wants proof of death — or the head. They have specific information about the target.

intelDialogue.high: I know exactly where they are — {dungeonName}. I watched them go in.
intelDialogue.medium: They're holed up in a ruin to the {direction}. I saw the approach.
intelDialogue.low: Last seen heading {direction}. That's all I know.
intelDialogue.none: I haven't seen them since the robbery.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Cull the {creaturePlural} Before Winter
sideQuestTemplates.description: A local farmer needs {count} {creaturePlural} killed before they raid the food stores. A den mother leads the pack.

intelDialogue.high: They've been seen near {dungeonName}. That's where the den mother nests.
intelDialogue.medium: Somewhere to the {direction}. That's where I've seen them come from.
intelDialogue.low: They come from the {direction}. That's all I know.
intelDialogue.none: I just know they keep coming.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Stop the {enemyType} Ritual at {dungeonName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: Word from the nearest settlement: a ritual sacrifice is scheduled. The ritual leader must be stopped within three rooms. There is no time to loot.

objectives.description: Stop the ritual leader within 3 rooms

intelDialogue.high: The ritual is tonight in {dungeonName}. You have three rooms — no more.
intelDialogue.medium: It's happening now. Somewhere in the ruins to the {direction}.
intelDialogue.low: You must hurry. I don't know where exactly.
intelDialogue.none: There is no time to explain. Go.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Recover the {itemType} of {familyName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: A grieving noble wants their family heirloom back — a {itemType} lost when {dungeonName} was overrun. It's on a body inside.

intelDialogue.high: It's on my cousin's body. In {dungeonName}. I couldn't retrieve it myself.
intelDialogue.medium: Someone carried it in. It should be near where they fell.
intelDialogue.low: It's in there somewhere. I last saw it years ago.
intelDialogue.none: I have nothing useful to tell you.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Don't Ask What It Is — Just Bring It Back
sideQuestTemplates.description: A sketchy merchant won't say what's in the crate. Only that it's theirs, it's in {dungeonName}, and they're paying well.

intelDialogue.high: It's in {dungeonName}. That's all you need to know.
intelDialogue.medium: Somewhere to the {direction}. I'm not saying more.
intelDialogue.low: You'll know it when you see it.
intelDialogue.none: Don't ask questions. Just bring it.

sideQuestTemplates.name: The {dungeonName} Held Our People's {relicName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: A cultural elder says an artifact looted generations ago is in {dungeonName}. Returning it would mean much to the settlement.

intelDialogue.high: It's in {dungeonName}. The elder knows which room.
intelDialogue.medium: It's in {dungeonName} somewhere. Our elders lost track of where.
intelDialogue.low: Somewhere in the ruins to the {direction}.
intelDialogue.none: The knowledge of its exact location was lost.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Bring Me Proof It's Dead
sideQuestTemplates.description: A mercenary captain needs confirmation of kill. The trophy drops from the creature — someone driven by Audacity can grab it without a full clear.

objectives.description: Bring back proof of the {creatureType}'s death

intelDialogue.high: It's in {dungeonName}. Our scouts confirmed it yesterday.
intelDialogue.medium: Somewhere to the {direction}. That terrain suits them.
intelDialogue.low: I only know the creature type. You'll have to track it.
intelDialogue.none: My client gave me nothing useful.

sideQuestTemplates.name: Why Are the {creaturePlural} Acting Strange?
sideQuestTemplates.description: A healer has noticed {creaturePlural} behaving abnormally — attacking outside their normal range and season. The cause is in room one of {dungeonName}.

objectives.description: Find the cause of the disturbance in {dungeonName}

intelDialogue.high: Check room one of {dungeonName}. That's where the disturbance originates.
intelDialogue.medium: Start near {dungeonName}. The answer should be near the entrance.
intelDialogue.low: I only know the {creaturePlural} have changed. Look for signs.

sideQuestTemplates.name: {count} {npcType} Vanished on the {roadName} Road
sideQuestTemplates.description: The guard captain found bodies but no witnesses. Evidence of what happened is in {dungeonName}. A partial report earns partial reward.

objectives.description: Find evidence of what happened in {dungeonName}

intelDialogue.high: The evidence is in {dungeonName}, room one. I've had scouts look.
intelDialogue.medium: Start in {dungeonName}. The bodies were found on that road.
intelDialogue.low: They disappeared on the {roadName} road. Check nearby ruins.

sideQuestTemplates.name: The {factionName} Are Hiding Something in {dungeonName}
sideQuestTemplates.description: A rival faction wants leverage. Evidence is in {dungeonName}. What the player does with the evidence after is their choice.

intelDialogue.high: The document is in room one of {dungeonName}. My informant confirmed it.
intelDialogue.medium: It's in {dungeonName} somewhere near the entrance.
intelDialogue.low: I believe something is hidden in the ruins to the {direction}.

sideQuestTemplates.name: That {dungeonName} Didn't Used to Be Dangerous
sideQuestTemplates.description: An old farmer says the dungeon used to be safe. Something changed. Someone driven by Curiosity understands why — others only see that it did.

intelDialogue.high: It changed three seasons ago. I know exactly when — check the oldest chamber.
intelDialogue.medium: Start at the entrance. Whatever changed began there.
intelDialogue.low: It used to be safe. Now it isn't. That's all I know.
intelDialogue.none: It just changed. I can't explain it.
